title: Coordinate-free machine learning identifies 1569 candidate stable materials
summary: A machine learning model using Wyckoff representations, coordinate-free sets of symmetry-related crystal positions, screened a combinatorially enumerable search space. From 5675 ab initio calculations it identified 1569 materials lying below the known convex hull of previously calculated materials. Stability is computational (ab initio) and the abstract reports no synthesis.
ai_technology: Machine learning model using coordinate-free Wyckoff representations to predict crystal stability

evidence.tested: Ab initio calculations of candidate materials against the known convex hull.
evidence.unknown: Synthesis and experimental stability of the predicted materials are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A machine learning model on Wyckoff representations prioritized candidates for ab initio calculation.
